definitions.explanation: Describes something proceeding without resistance or obstacles, going as expected.
Describes an elegant, slender body shape or figure.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}はすんなり{進|すす}んだ。
すんなりした{体型|たいけい}の{女性|じょせい}。
examples.english: A woman with a slender figure.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{提案|ていあん}はすんなり{受|う}け{入|い}れられた。
{手続|てつづ}きがすんなり{終|お}わって{助|たす}かった。
examples.english: I was glad the procedure went smoothly.

examples.japanese: すんなりとした{指|ゆび}がきれいだ。
すんなりした{脚|あし}で、モデルみたいだ。
examples.english: She has slender legs, like a model.

notes:
NUANCE:
すんなり implies a natural, effortless quality—things happen without forcing or struggling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すんなり{通|とお}る: to pass through easily
- すんなり{受|う}け{入|い}れる: to accept readily
- すんなりいく: to go smoothly
- すんなりした{足|あし}: slender legs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スムーズに: smoothly (loanword)
- {順調|じゅんちょう}に: smoothly, going well
- すらりと: slenderly, gracefully
